dog.description_text:
My foster writes:
Gold Star is a sweet, affectionate, energetic kitten! His favorite thing is both giving and receiving kisses, and coming to excitedly greet you at the door when he hears you get home! He happily allows all handling, and even tends to fall asleep comfortably cradled in your arms like a baby. He is a total lap cat and will become your shadow, jumping up to come with you wherever you go, whether you're brushing your teeth or cuddling up with him on the couch. He's a very smart boy for his age, is fully litter box trained, and picks up on household routines quickly. He LOVES to play and is not aggressive at all towards humans or other cats, so he would do very well with a resident cat that can tolerate his high energy level or a home with children. Overall, Gold Star is absolutely full of love and affection, making him ideal to be your forever companion!
dog.name: Gold Star
